verdict.rationale: Reclaim.ai is a SaaS scheduling product, so versioned public APIs with a deprecation policy is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack contains no API documentation, no versioning scheme and no deprecation policy. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404, and the only programmatic surface found, an auth-gated MCP endpoint, has no vendor docs, so it says nothing about versioning or deprecation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
